name: How do I connect utilities (water, sewer, electricity) to my tiny home?
description: Utility connections require licensed professionals to extend existing lines or install new ones for water, sewer, and electricity according to local codes.

mainEntity.name: How do I connect utilities (water, sewer, electricity) to my tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Connecting utilities involves professional installation by licensed contractors to meet local codes. Water and sewer lines typically extend from existing connections on the property or require new tap-ins if available. Electrical connections usually tie into the main service panel of the primary residence or a new separate service, depending on local regulations and the tiny home's power needs. Zen Tiny Homes can coordinate with utility providers and contractors to ensure proper and compliant hookups.
